mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_import_log (knowledge_no, old_version, new_version, content_hash, action, source_file) VALUES (#{knowledgeNo}, #{oldVersion}, #{newVersion}, #{contentHash}, #{action}, #{sourceFile})
mapper.select: SELECT l.knowledge_no, l.source_file FROM ai_knowledge_import_log l JOIN (SELECT knowledge_no, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM ai_knowledge_import_log WHERE source_file IS NOT NULL GROUP BY knowledge_no) m ON m.knowledge_no = l.knowledge_no AND m.max_id = l.id
